overview: A full-featured e-commerce store for spare parts covering 9 equipment types: JCB, tractor, crane, bulldozer, car, bikes, aeroplane, scooty, and truck. Browse by equipment type, search parts by name or number, view detailed part pages with compatibility info, and complete checkout with order confirmation.
features: Product detail pages with compatibility info and stock status
50+ seeded spare parts across all equipment types
